in_sanskrit.name: शरण्क्षा
in_sanskrit.meaning: One who has the power to crush the enemy.
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: शर: (shara) - arrow अंक्ष: (anksha) - desire, longing, or craving Therefore, Sharanksha is one who has the power to crush the enemy with her desire or longing.

in_hindi.name: शरण्क्षा
in_hindi.long_meaning: विघ्न (vighna) - obstacle नाश (nash) - destroy Therefore, Sharanksha is one who destroys obstacles.

in_tamil.name: ஶரண்க்ஷா
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஓடு (odu) - enemy க்குள்ள (kul) - near உற்பத்தி (urpatti) - power Therefore, Sharanksha is one who has the power to destroy the enemy.

in_telugu.name: శరణఙ్శ
in_telugu.long_meaning: ఎయ్యాదు (eyyadu) - enemy యేదుయేశ్యోదీ (yeduyesyodo) - one who crushes the enemy Therefore, Sharanksha is one who crushes the enemy.

in_marathi.name: Sharanksha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Power and Strength
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharanksha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sharanksha is the name of a powerful goddess in Hindu mythology. She is also known as Shakti or Durga. Her name means 'Goddess of Power and Strength' and she is often depicted holding a weapon in each hand. Sharanksha is worshipped by many Hindus for her ability to bestow courage and strength upon her devotees.
